gamerule.ig.sword_cooldown_ticks.descrip: Cooldown duration for Swords in ticks (1/20 sec). Vanilla is ~12-16 depending on material. Set to 4 for IG speed.
gamerule.ig.axe_cooldown_ticks.descripti: Cooldown duration for Axes. Vanilla is very slow (~20+). Set to 8 for a weighty but fast feel.
gamerule.ig.shovel_cooldown_ticks.descri: Cooldown duration for Shovels. Usually very fast.
gamerule.ig.hoe_cooldown_ticks.descripti: Cooldown duration for Hoes. Recommended: 1 tick for 'spam-hoe' combat.
gamerule.ig.generic_cooldown_ticks.descr: Cooldown for any item not in a specific category (unarmed, torches, etc.).
gamerule.ig.prevent_item_swap_cooldown.d: If enabled, switching items will NOT reset your attack cooldown. Allows 'Hotbar Comboing'.
gamerule.ig.enable_combat_juice.descript: Enables enhanced visual particles and pitch-shifted sounds when landing high-charge attacks.
